content: Formula SAE EV Telemetry (graymarshall.dev writeup): distributed pipeline (on-car protobuf over MQTT into Kafka, multi-schema Postgres, Grafana + custom Next.js viewer), 120+ signals at 1kHz, P99 latency <40ms, Leaflet/D3/three.js track mapping; explicitly cites spotty trackside connectivity and high-frequency CAN load as the real operational challenge, and needed a one-command trackside launcher script to be usable in the field.
